fixes.where: canopy.css .tree__canopy mask (rows 1200–1260) + canopy.js block 2 canopy sway ±0.5°
fixes.what: Move the canopy's fade-out above the shrub leaves (mask #000 at 1140·--s → transparent at 1200·--s) and halve the sway to ±0.25°; give the sprig masks a hard 20-row edge instead of the 60-row fade.
fixes.why: At row 1200 a 0.5° swing about the top is ~10px lateral: the shrub foliage in the seam reads as ghosted/double-edged (desktop-1 y 760–900, desktop-2 y 90–330), a rendering glitch rather than motion.

fixes.what: Add a bottom cypress ramp: linear-gradient(rgba(27,34,30,.42) 0%, rgba(27,34,30,.72) 60%, var(--night) 100%).
fixes.why: On phones the video's table and chairs show through the canopy's open middle at the bottom of screen 1 as a bright patch; the foliage should sit on night, not on footage.

fixes.what: Add one static leaf crop (.leaf.leaf--3, right edge, aria-hidden, display:none on phones) to each inner page band.
fixes.why: The painted tree is the brand's signature frame and it vanishes after the first click; the inner pages read as a generic dark template.

fixes.what: Overlay the band with a 25% cypress tint on phones (background: linear-gradient(rgba(27,34,30,.25),rgba(27,34,30,.25)), url(trunk-band.webp)).
fixes.why: At 390px the 35px bark strips are bright, high-contrast and repetitive: they read as a wallpaper border, not trunks, and compete with the parchment copy.

fixes.what: Drop it (or opacity .45): the pasted leaf over the bare trunk at the top of screen 4.
fixes.why: It sits on the bark in a lighter, more translucent paint style and reads as a sticker, not part of the tree.

fixes.what: Centre the submit row (text-align:center on its wrapper) to match the centred heading, kashida and call line.
fixes.why: Every other element on the roots screen is centred; the left-aligned gold button breaks the axis of the composition.
